launcher_icon._doc: The launcher icon, generated from this declaration by 1_cicd/src/scripts/cloud-android-launcher-icons.py (pattern + category colours + glyphs in 1_cicd/src/data/launcher-icons.json). Never edit the generated res files.

name: cloud-shopping
description: Cloud Shopping (#1473): a deals and listings browser over mock data. Navigation is ONE collapsed left side menu (libs:ui-nav-bars vertical_side_menu: the rail on a phone, the full menu on a wide screen) in five groups, Feed (Home: the deals of every page), Things (Groceries, Electronics, Clothing), Services (Transport, Hotels), Assets (Real Estate, Business, Jobs) and Entertainment (Events); the bottom nav holds exactly one item, a search icon with no label, which searches every page. Every page has its own top filter tabs and its rows, both declared in app/src/main/assets/shop/shop.json (mock data, nothing is fetched and no shop is contacted); a row is the ui-kit KitStoreRow (the Cloud Store's dense row) in the shared type ramp. Configs are the fleet's General | Perms | About. Offline, declares no network permission of its own.

signing._doc: ONE shared Cloud-constellation signing key for ALL Android apps. KEY LOCATION: Shared/Providers/D_TOOLS-DEVICES/d2-android/release.jks (OU=Cloud Constellation) + Shared/Providers/D_TOOLS-DEVICES/d2-android/signing.secrets.yaml.

auto_update._doc_max_installs_per_pass: Most install sessions ONE unattended background pass may open. A background pass cannot show the system install dialog (Android 10+ blocks background activity starts), so each install it starts leaves a tap-to-install notification holding a PackageInstaller session until the user answers it. Unbounded, one pass over the 40-entry fleet opens 40 and the installer hits Android's 50-session cap - 'Too many active sessions for UID'. The remainder is picked up by the next pass. User-initiated 'Update all' is NOT capped: it runs in the foreground where the dialog appears and sessions resolve at once.
auto_update._doc_enabled: Off because this app compiles no libs:updater: the Store updates it, as it does Cloud Calc and Cloud Search.

ui._doc: #868 THE nav declaration (libs:bottomnav NavDecl) of Cloud Shopping. ui.bottom_nav holds ONE section, search (a search icon, drawn WITHOUT a label: assets/shop/shop.json::chrome.bottom_labels), declared in nav-shape.json::single_bottom because N1 asks for two or more. The pages are the ONE section `shop`, default_section, drawn in vertical_side_menu mode (the collapsed rail; libs:ui-nav-bars NavSectionLayout) with the owner's five groups. Each page's filter tabs and mock rows are assets/shop/shop.json::pages[<page id>] (test-shopping-app.sh holds the ids in step both ways); the Feed page has no rows of its own: it aggregates the deals of every other page.

configs_pages._doc: Configs > General and Configs > About (libs:ui-nav-bars fleetconfigs, rule 1_cicd/src/data/configs-pages.json, #1352 v2). general.sections: the anchors of the one General page, in order (perms, battery, storage, notifications, ui, language are required; app opens this app's own Configs; update is added after perms by default). about: the hand-written part of the extensive About: tagline, description, features, screens, guide, privacy, backends (ids of ac_cloud-account/build.json::fleet_endpoints, resolved to mesh URLs at build time), related fleet apps, credits for a fork. Permissions, data stores, crash/analytics libs, name, icon, version, build sha and date, repo, licence, origin, crash sink, debug API and changelog are derived, never typed here.

about.tagline: Deals and listings, one side menu
about.description: Cloud Shopping browses deals and listings in one dense list: a collapsed side menu groups the pages (Feed, Things, Services, Assets, Entertainment), each page has its own filter tabs, and a search icon on the bottom bar searches them all. Today every row is mock data bundled with the app; no shop is contacted.
features: Feed: the deals of every page
guide: Open the side menu for a page.
Pick a filter tab at the top.
Tap the search icon to look across pages.
about.privacy: No ads and no third-party trackers. A crash report is saved on the phone and sent only to the phone's own C3 WebServer over loopback; nothing leaves the device unless you share it. It calls no fleet service: its data is mock data bundled with the app.

related.why: Opens this app from Cloud > Apps > Services.

perms._doc: #1360 every grant this app needs, by libs:perms catalogue id (needs), and the fleet apps that do work for it with the grants THEY must hold (helpers). The ONE declaration: generated into assets/app-perms.json (cloud-android-perms-guard.py --write), drawn by Configs > General > Perms (libs:perms AppPermsSection) with live state, Grant / Open and Grant all, asked at first run (first_run), and reported as 'Missing permission X - Grant' when an operation fails (PermsGate). perms-guard fails when code uses a gated API or another app's engine that is not declared here, or when the manifest and this list disagree.
